tagline: Early code: one verifier that gathers the results of the checks of a design and says what is confirmed and what is inconclusive.
description: EH3D-DESIGN-VERIFIER gathers the results of the checks of a design from a JSON file, checks that each finding has a stable code and an object, gives a verdict that keeps confirmed failures apart from inconclusive results and writes the review document. The checks themselves and the comparison with a manufacturing profile are planned. It has run only on data made by its own tests.
